title: Jaxson Dart injury: NY Giants’ QB could miss the remainder of the 2026 season

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jaxson Dart injury: NY Giants’ QB could miss the remainder of the 2026 season
sources.description: The MRI on New York Giants’ quarterback Jaxson Dart’s left knee revealed an injury more severe than was believed on Monday night, per NFL insiders Mike Garafolo and Ian Rapoport. Dart could miss the remainder of the 2026 season. Giants head coach John Harbaugh would not confirm the reports that Dart would miss the season. […]
